episodes.name: Members Only
episodes.overview: Gene Pontecorvo makes a final break from the mob life, while Junior's paranoid delusions could be the end of Tony.

episodes.name: Join the Club
episodes.overview: The family tries to cope with Tony's hospitalization and possibly impending death, while Tony begins to hallucinate a new life parallel to his own.

episodes.name: Mayham
episodes.overview: While the gang begins to turn on itself, Tony finds himself at the threshold.

episodes.name: The Fleshy Part of the Thigh
episodes.overview: Tony goes home and returns to business, perhaps with a new frame of mind. Paulie receives a shock about his mother.

episodes.name: Mr. & Mrs. John Sacrimoni Request...
episodes.overview: Johnny Sack asks for permission to get out of jail for his daughters wedding; Tony's on the look out for personal protection.

episodes.name: Live Free or Die
episodes.overview: Tony seeks guidance from overseas to solve a local problem; and decides whether a top earner deserves another chance.

episodes.name: Luxury Lounge
episodes.overview: Chris meets and beats the stars, while Artie turns violent after having his hospitality abused.

episodes.name: Johnny Cakes
episodes.overview: Vito considers starting a new life in New Hampshire, while Anthony continues his pursuit of revenge against Junior.

episodes.name: The Ride
episodes.overview: Paulie finds public opinion turned against him after an amusement ride accident, while Chris tries to start a new life as a husband and father.

episodes.name: Moe n' Joe
episodes.overview: Tony reflects on how growing up with Janice colors his attitudes now, while Vito tries to make a new life for himself in New Hampshire.

episodes.name: Cold Stones
episodes.overview: Phil takes out his revenge on Vito, while Tony grows frustrated with Anthony's lack of ambition or work ethic.

episodes.name: Kaisha
episodes.overview: Phil Leotardo seeks to continue a cycle of retaliation between the New York and Jersey families. Christopher wrestles with his addictions. Tony decides keeping Carmela occupied with the spec house is for the best. A.J. gets a new girlfriend.

episodes.name: Soprano Home Movies
episodes.overview: Bobby and Janice host a wild 47th birthday bash for Tony at their Adirondacks vacation home. Tony's actions following Johnny Sack's arrest come back to haunt him.

episodes.name: Stage 5
episodes.overview: Christopher's Cleaver premieres, showing Tony how he feels about him. Johnny Sack faces a health crisis. Phil Leotardo resents his family, and himself, for being weak and downtrodden. Silvio gets caught up in New York's power vacuum.

episodes.name: Remember When
episodes.overview: When Tony's first hit is about to be unearthed, he and Paulie flee to Florida, where Tony contemplates their friendship. Junior organizes a poker game at the institution. The New York power struggle continues.

episodes.name: Chasing It
episodes.overview: Maria Spatafore requests help from Tony for Vito, Jr. Tony's bad luck puts a rift between he and Hesh. A.J. makes a major choice regarding his future.

episodes.name: Walk Like a Man
episodes.overview: The relationship between Christopher and Paulie's falters, while A.J. grows depressed over his break-up with Blanca.

episodes.name: Kennedy and Heidi
episodes.overview: The Soprano and Lupertazzi crime families quarrel over asbestos removal. Tony deals with a problematic associate. Paulie suffers a devastating personal loss. A.J. questions his friendship with Jasons Parisi and Gervasi.

episodes.name: The Second Coming
episodes.overview: Tony attempts to repair the rift between New Jersey and New York. A.J.'s depression struggle continues. A New York associate crosses the line with Meadow.

episodes.name: The Blue Comet
episodes.overview: The spectre of disloyalty among the crew hangs over Tony as Phil Leotardo decides how to handle recent issues with the Soprano crime family. A hit gone wrong comes at a huge cost. A.J.'s conquering of his depression is challenged.

episodes.name: Made in America
episodes.overview: Tony seeks to find a peace with the Leotardo crew while dealing with rumors a member of his own crew may have flipped. A.J. makes a decision regarding his future and Junior's slide into dementia continues.

name: Season 6
overview: As the final episodes take shape, Tony faces a myriad of stress-inducing crises at home, at work, and from the law. While his wife and children each make choices that promise to change the face of the Sopranos' domestic life, Tony also comes to doubt the allegiances of some of those closest to him at work . . . none of whom is above suspicion.
